scope: Profile-scoped browser-local persistence for opt-in activity notification dismissals; new operation outcome remains visible; malformed or excessive client data is bounded.

reproduction.observed: 4 tests, 1 failed: a previously dismissed terminal outcome reappeared after remount before implementation.

verification.details: TypeScript typecheck and Vite production build; existing >500 kB chunk warning.

protections: No external notification sends or provider calls were added.
Only profile-owned operation IDs, outcomes and timestamps are stored in same-origin browser storage; no operation details or user content.
At most 100 short dismissal keys persist; corrupt, oversize or blocked storage fails safely to session-local behavior.
limitations: Local browser storage is per-device, not cross-device synchronized.
Node.js v27 alpha emitted an npm support warning; hosted CI on supported Node remains required.
No TalentHop authenticated journey or HAR was performed; separate reconnaissance claim is owned elsewhere.
